scope: Gain and transpose device graphs across playback, live replacement, Undo and save/reopen
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none, Qt offscreen platform, silent preview clock

desktop-asan device tests.note: Local FL_LIVE_SANITIZERS=ON desktop build, ASAN detect_leaks=0 for Qt: qmlDeviceJourney, deviceAutomationInSession, deviceEditing, gainDeviceOutput, transposeDeviceOutput, deviceChainsInSession, qmlDeviceEditing, qmlDeviceAutomation

verified_behaviors: QML journey: transpose +12 and gain -6 added and set, gain automated -60 -> 0 dB over bar 1, played, transpose edited and undone while playing, stopped with no voices, saved and exported

Float export oracle at every 1999th frame: |sample| = (0.25 * factor) * (0.7 * 0.1) while a template note sounds, 0 between notes, with factor linear from 10^-3 to 1 over bar 1 and 1 after; zero crossings in bar 2 match twice C4/E4/G4/C5 within 3
Reopening in a fresh window exports identical samples (stable parameter state and bindings)
About 80 device edits while playing (two devices, one automated) with a panic midway; playback edits activate; Undo back to the reopened state exports the original samples; Stop leaves no voice

Earlier receipts: device-graph.json (invalid graph rejection), device-editing.json (gain/transpose oracles), device-automation.json (lanes), plan-replacement.json and edit-bursts.json (replacement/retirement ownership and bounded work)
limits: Offscreen platform and silent preview clock; no physical audio or real-time deadline measurement.
